After much delay and name changes (Commando '86 and Commando '87), this game was ultimately published on the 6-Pak compilation as Duet.

Choose your tactics. Either go it alone and rely on your stealth and cunning to penetrate enemy territory or be part of a human machine - a crack Commando pair where survival means co-operation and teamwork. Whatever your method, the brief remains the same - collect vital documents from each area and return safely. The task is not an easy one. With minefields to avoid, tanks and foot patrols to out maneuver, the odds are heavily against you. So grit your teeth and prepare for combat!

197731.overview:
You are the dictator of the fictional republic of Ritimba. Your task is to keep everybody happy - the army, the peasants, the land owners.... while secretly filling your personal bank account as much as possible. You've got the secret police on your side... and the guerrillas on the other one.

Every month, one of those groups makes a request. You can accept it (which might involve quite a bit of money) or deny it, making groups either happy or not. You can also choose to borrow money from the Russians or the Americans.

As the old saying goes.. it's impossible to make everybody happy. So sooner or later, you'll be facing a revolution or assassination attempt. Did you purchase that helicopter or are you going to face the music?

197906.overview: Welcome to the Dungeon Master, an adventure game based upon the development of a character the fate of whom is decided partly by chance but mostly by the actions of you, the player. The  Dungeon  Master differs from standard text adventures in that the dangers and rewards are not pre-determined by the program but can be set up and tailor-made to suit the experience of the individual player and their character.

197907.overview:
Dungeons of Doom is a double games pack with both games playing the same for one to four players but having different scenarios as you step into a deserted castle. In Dungeons of Doom you have to move downwards through the dungeons to find the treasure, while Escape from the Underworld has you falling through the floor and having to move upwards to the entrance to the castle.

The games are played on a 10 x 10 cube and on the screen you have a map of your location plus the surrounding areas. You must move around through the corridors and up and down stairs searching rooms that you encounter. There are hazards and creatures who occupy certain rooms and when you encounter a creature you have a short time to decide whether to fight, use a spell or retreat. You have a certain amount of hit points and this reduces with every trap, incident or a fight with the creatures. Each player has one move before the next player has a turn.

197908.overview:
Long ago there was a bloody battle between the Dwarfs and the Orcs. Although the 
dwarfs were victorious they lost their leader Krane who had fought with the legendary Golden Bow and Arrow 0f Condor, (a gift from the Gods). In the heat 0f the battle these weapons were stolen by an Orc and hidden in the dwarfs domain. Nobody knows where they are. Can you, the great adventurer, find these weapons and return them. 

This is an adventure that will keep you going lor a long time.

198473.overview: Kids TV show Round the Bend was set in a fictitious comic factory - one with amazingly even more toilet humor than the real things. In this licensed game Doc Croc has blown up the printing press, and Lou Brush must go through the sewers to retrieve all 8 pages. After selecting a section from the initial screen of pipes, gameplay involves moving through scrolling platform sections in order to reach the sheets. Once this is done each page is played out as a single-screen multi-layered screen. The specific settings are influenced by the TV show, including Doc Croc’s Nursery Crimes, The False Teeth Versus the Atomic Banana, and Kenny McTickle and His Magic Kilt.

199548.overview:
Dungeon Adventure concludes Level 9's Middle Earth lineage of fantasy interactive fiction games (later reprogrammed with graphics in Jewels of Darkness). The player is searching for magical treasures within the Demon Lord's fortress, after his defeat in Adventure Quest.

There are over 200 specific locations, including rooms within the tower and outdoor locations to navigate en route. Objects range from a coffin and a giant belt to nasty images and a packing case; also watch out for Orcs, Dwarves and other creatures. The parser's vocabulary contains all the standard terms - EXAMINE, TAKE, OPEN and FILL for example.

199558.overview: You have 12 hours to solve the murder of Mr. Marshall Robner. If it was a murder... Mr Robner was found locked in his library, dead -- from a lethal dosage of anti-depressants. Friends and family are calling this a suicide of depressed wealthy industrialist. As Chief of Detectives, you find something just doesn't smell right about this case. You go out on a quest to find a suspect, his motive, method, and opportunity.

199618.overview:
Druids Moon brings back Tommy Astle, the hero from one of Charles'earlier games, Werewolf Simulator. We learn that Tommy has always had an interest in the magic and culture of the Druids. Now, with an intense feeling of being called by someone or something, he has travelled into the depths of the English countryside to learn his fate. He is staying at an olde worlde inn at Aven-bury. It is here that we join him at the start of an adventure that may well change his whole life. Mapping is not quite so devious as in Werewolf Simulator, but you must still take care to explore the terrain with pencil and paper at hand. Exploring the surrounding roads and woods, you realise that there is more to Avenbury than first meets the eye. 

The number of locations is not very large, but it is what you do in these locations that is going to be vitally important. As with other games from the same author, useful items are not obvious, you must actively look for them. The first location is a good example: There are many useful things just lying around or within view, but you must SEARCH, EXAMINE, LOOK IN and LOOK UNDER everything you can think of to find what is there. The program is written using Incentive's Graphic Adventure Creator and has the usual limitations of graphic design and parser. With that in mind, the graphics are an improvement over earlier adventures and the parser will accept sufficiently complex commands to make life a little interesting. The amount of descriptive text is limited but still sets the scene adequately. The atmosphere is more in the mind than on the screen and builds quite nicely to the climax, which has a nice twist. There can be no comparison between the elegant operation of something like Jinxter or Knight Ore and Druids Moon, but then there is a great difference in price. GAC games are still fairly common and represent much of the bread and butter for our adventure appetites. Long may they be so. Never released on its own, it was only released as part of a Top Ten Software compilation named Bogies Pick 3.

200408.overview:
-The Dark: Redux- . Many years ago the army of dark forces has crossed the border of the Land of Winds.
Most of the population have been killed, others have escaped to the Northern Lands.
Among them there was a girl by name Jane. Soon she gave birth to a son, Alexander.
Jane told him the sad story. And when he became an adult, he went to the native land to free his country.

This game is the remastered version of The Dark with reworked intro, updated in-game graphics and new loading screen.
Gameplay and maps have not changed. 

-The Dark: Lost Pages- ,  is a B-side of upcoming Big Box release of The Dark. Redux. The game tells the same story as the main game. Try to collect all the pages of The Book of History. 
Prologue is a huge maze that needs to be explored, discovering new parts of it. And then the game turns into FPS with 9 new maps (and they are larger and more diverse than in the main game) and new types of enemies, including a fire-breathing dragon.

201166.overview:
Life does not forgive weakness.

Dan will have to pay for all his unpunished acts.

Dantemonium will be his place of reception as punishment.

These are the words of the high priest of the German Catholic Church.

Dan will face all kinds of physical and mental torture. The only option to get out alive is to escape from the Dantemonium Cathedral, where all kinds of monstrosities and despicable beings are housed who have also paid for their actions in the past, and have been locked up to unleash their heinous murderous instincts.

Can Dan regain his identity and find out what happened to him?

Why has he been locked up in a German Church called Dantemonium?

201192.overview:
A short demonstration of Magicland Dizzy that explains how Dizzy found his way to Magicland. It consists of a series of five screens (and one non-interactive screen). The objective is to repair the broken generator for the teleportation machine. Only a few items and one NPC are available.

Released on the Crash Magazine issue 84: Presents 20 Covertape.

201255.overview:
It’s a tough life being flushed away! Guide young Turdesley in his adventures down the pipe, dodging and shooting all manner of strange nasties with his trusty condo-cannon.

Travel through the worlds ‘Pipe Central’, ‘Skull City’ and ‘The Kingdom of Mighty Two’

Destroy Mighty Two and head to the sea for a well earned holiday.

Playing the Game

Pressing fire will suck in our hero’s cheeks and send him down for quick-fire shooting. Pressing up and fire together for stationary shooting. Pressing down will again shrink Turdesley for quick movement and to get through narrow passageways.

Follow the arrows and signs which show the way to the exit points.

Energy blobs can be released by shooting multiple nasties. Beware of moving blobs that will zap energy as well as pipes and other scenery.

Side A contains the 48K game packed with beeper music and SFX
Side B contains the 128K version with extra AY music and graphics

Powered By SEUD

Available for free (name your own price) on itch.io, or as a physical copy from Phoenix Ware.

201551.overview: The Dark Hospital is the first game in the new horror mystery adventure saga for ZX Spectrum Noisy Valley. In this first episode, the story allows the player to incarnate as a man whose young daughter remains admitted to the city hospital, but who has little or nothing to do with the one he remembered until recently.

201580.overview:
Dead Meat is a Spanish language zombie themed dungeon crawler for the ZX Spectrum. It was developed and released in 2021 by Andrew "Briefer" Llano and published on his itch.io page.

Escape from the infected city of zombies before it is too late!

202402.overview:
An antihero, an ancient legend, a cult of priestesses, horrible monsters, killer clowns, strange messages, old pictures...  all this and much more on Furillo Productions' first interactive text adventure for the ZX Spectrum 128k! Are you going to miss it?

Bernard Valley, a dystopian June 1980...  Peter Parrish is a lonesome and shady ex-director of obscure "customer service" companies. He is  about to leave Arrollito and Pozolón, the turtles that his nephews gave him for his birthday that does not want to clean and feed, at the pond of the village, the place where everybody abandons their pets... Parrish will soon realize that his life will change forever.

202915.overview:
The 2017 ZX Spectrum game, Crystal Kingdom Dizzy is a stunning remake of the 1992 original, featuring updated graphics running in a 50fps engine, six new 128K tunes and a superb loading screen. 
* Programmed by Evgeniy Barskiy
* In-game graphics by Dmitri Ponomarjov
* GUI design & menu pictures by Oleg Origin
* Music covered by Sergey Kosov
* Title picture by Marco Antonio del Campo

The magical crystal treasure has been stolen and scattered all over the islands, so it is up to Dizzy to find them and restore order. Once again, Dizzy's main enemy is the pirates, and some deadly island creatures, but all Dizzy's friends are around to help out when the going gets tough.

204611.overview:
The Double is a football management simulator based on the English Football League and includes all the four top divisions from the 80s. The idea of the game is to manage a team from the bottom division and take them all the way to the top division and win 'The Double', which consists of winning the League and The FA Cup in the same season.

At the start of the game you are presented with a team and a contract for you to agree with. After agreeing terms you are then taken to various menus which allow you to manage your team. All the usual options are there from team selection, transfers, scouting reports, finances, ground improvements and various other options to improve your team.

After you are happy with your selections you are then taken to the actual game. Here you can watch your game, see just the results or watch another game. You watch the game from an elevated side view showing part of the pitch. After the result, win, draw or lose you then use the menus to once again improve your team and take them to the top.

205902.overview:
Uncle Scrooge with his nephews and Webby set off for the Carpathian country, where there is a long-abandoned old castle called Fort Cockroach. Legend says that untold riches are still kept there and no one has ever been able to find them. But, reaching the treasury in the dungeon of the castle, Scrooge and his nephews fall into a trap. Tired of waiting for anyone outside, Webby collects several stones by the river and decides to enter the old castle to find and save her friends.

Try to open the best ending and make Uncle Scrooge very happy with the treasures found.

The game is available in two languages: English and Ukrainian.

207813.overview: Slovak text adventure game that was recently re-released in English. After your 1st success (in the last game), the feared Cosa Nostra has shown an interest. You've been sent to a pacific island of Bukapao. The task: Kill the island president - Amatom Bugampa, who's been obstructing the flow of American drugs to the Pacific, and ruining your bosses'  business. Customs are strict, so you go to the island "for pleasure" by the Adria cruise ship. The gun you need must be obtained there.

207814.overview: A Slovak created text adventure recently translated into English by the original creators. In some ways this is more of a menu-driven "simulation" than a text adventure. In it you are a contract killer that must make your way to success amongst the seedy side of the world.

211280.overview:
For Centuries, five huge prison ships floated around Zia in the Luma System, filled with prisoners whose uprising was quashed by Malik and the Wardens around Zan. Now believed to be just a story and if true the prisoners would be long dead, the story has become true as the five ships have arrived in orbit in Zan with large cargo's of mutated prisoners. To make matters worse, the prisoners have managed to eat through the hulls and are planning an escape. You have been assigned to send and control five Supertronic crafts to fly over the hulls of the five ships and seal all the holes as well as destroy any escaped prisoners. Each craft can be selected and controlled at any time. As well as the mutants to destroy or avoid, there are also defences on each ship and if touched or hit by a weapon then the craft loses power.

The five Supertronic crafts are able to transform into four different modes to help them in the their mission. The four modes are:

Hibar Mode: The craft shuts down all of it's systems and uses no power but can't be controlled. When a craft has run out of power it transforms into this mode and is lost.
Solar Mode: When power is low, this mode activates solar panels to power back up and can be left to power up when other crafts are being controlled.
Killar Mode: Enables the craft to use it's weapons to kill any mutants or destroy each ships defences. Weapon power pads can be collected when in Rovar Mode.
Rovar Mode: This mode allows the craft to land on the hull of the ships via landing/take-off pads and seal any holes in the ships.

213983.overview: 3D-Dotty is a pseudo 3D Pac-Man clone released by Dollarsoft in 1984.

215213.overview: Another Jet Set Willy clone from the prolific Adam Britton, this one appears to have been heavily influenced by the space sections in Jet Set Willy II.

215252.overview:
While walking, Dizzy becomes aware that the Space Invaders want to attack the planet.
To save the planet, Dizzy must go on a journey to the weird country and find a rocket there.

217457.overview: Doom for the ZX Spectrum was an unauthorized fan game version of Doom for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum home computer system running the TR-DOS operating system. It was developed by Spectrum programmers Sauron and RPSG of the Russian Digital Reality demo team. An early demo was included as a covertape feature in a 1997 issue of ZX Files Megatape 1. A more fleshed-out pre-release version 1.5 was also made available later. A final complete version of the game was never released, however.

218883.overview:
The Devil's Hand is a text adventure (with graphics) for the ZX Spectrum  it was developed and published by Compass Software in 1988. It is part of the "Demon Quadrilogy" which also includes 1986's Demon from the Darkside, 1987's The Golden Mask, and 1990's Shadows of the Past.

The game is also known as Demon From The Darkside III: The Final Conflict as it was originally just supposed to be a trilogy, but ended up with the fourth game in 1990.

418158.overview:
Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde is a text adventure based on the novel by R. L. Stevenson. In this game, you play the role of Dr. Jekyll/Mr. Hyde. The year is 1868 and you are close to the completion of your work into the human psyche. The game starts in your drawing room the night before Dr. Jekyll creates the potion that will transform him into Mr. Hyde.

The Spectrum version of the game is divided into three parts (Dichotomies, Duality, and Denouement). The goal of the first part is to mix up the potion that will transform you into Mr. Hyde. In part two, Mr. Hyde starts dominating over Dr. Jekyll, and in the last part, it is time to get rid of Mr. Hyde once and for all.

The Spectrum version was created using Professional Adventure Writer

418813.overview:
Welcome to the fantastic world of L'Enfant Terrible Circus. Today we will surprise you with some great acts of courage, coordination, balance, magic and much more ...

Before the show starts, please meet Dan Terkai, the artist who will be with us tonight. Tonight he comes to show us how much flesh and blood he will be able to endure for his full regeneration. A round of applause to this great artist who will show us all his talent without total humiliation.

420029.overview: Dominetris is a Tetris/Columns clone for the ZX Spectrum. However, instead of using the traditional blocks, it uses dominoes! The game was developed by hobbyist coder, Bob Smith and published by Cronosoft in 2005.

420030.overview:
Double Dealer is a compilation of two card gambling games published by MFM Software in 1984. 

The first game is a blackjack game, and the other is a stud poker game.

420162.overview:
Meet Aura, she's a delivery duck who just got transported to another dimension. Finding a note she wonders who needs setting free with stars and from what?  

Using Aura's skills navigate the hostile environment by slaying foes, collecting keys, throwing switches and even lay an egg to reach higher spots.

420460.overview: Dead by Dawn is a pseudo 3D horror themed arcade adventure game for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum. It was developed by Malcolm Kirk using Incentive Software's 3D Construction Kit. The game was published by Monsterbytes in 2012.

424455.overview:
In the poem "KING" by MARC PEIRSON, the subject of the poem is a monstrous and
despotic glutton. Somebody who has more regard for the disgusting and excessive
eating habits he enjoys so much than he has for the race of half-human goblins
he rules over. Such is KING - an altogether despicable creature, more despised
than loved and one whose very name strikes terror into the souls of the weak.

On the eve of an important festival, his wilful daughter elopes with a young
singer, taking with her a box containing the city's greatest treasure. Unknown
to her and her troubadour, the "treasure" is in fact a very powerful weapon which
is capable of destroying the entire city ... if not the entire kingdom. However,
she is safe enough as long as the box stays CLOSED, but if she should OPEN it then
the world as she knows it could come to an end.

In this game our hero is King's "dogboy" - a mute boy who can understand the ways
and language of the animals and the birds. These animals quickly learn what the
princess has done and are anxious to escape before she is foolish enough to open
the box.

The poor old "dogboy" on the other hand has his job to attend to - somebody has to
see to the safety of the dogs. However, it is also his "destiny" to descend into
the "Caves of Illusion" beneath Cuckoo Hill, because it is here that he will to able
to solve the mysteries of the netherworld. It is here that he will to able to discover
the means to rescue his fellow goblins and it is here that he will attain his heart's
desire.


SPECIAL COMMANDS

I or INVENTORY gives a list of everything the "dogboy" is carrying.
L redescribes the current location.
TEXT changes the game to a TEXT-ONLY adventure.
GRAPHICS changes it back to a "picture-based" adventure.
SAVE saves a game position to TAPE
STORE saves a game position to MEMORY
LOAD restores a game position from TAPE
RESTORE restores a game position from MEMORY
It is also possible to "chain" your commands by means of the word "AND" ... such as
GET THE SWORD AND DROP THE SPEAR. Use the word "IT" to refer to the last noun used.
For example ... GET THE SWORD AND EXAMINE IT. You may also use the word "EVERYTHING"
in the following manner ... DROP EVERYTHING EXCEPT THE SHIELD.

425617.overview:
Magica De Spell, an evil witch, kidnaps Scrooge's nephews and Webby, demanding all Scrooge's fortune and his lucky dime for ransom. After receiving a letter with conditions for children's return from Magica, Scrooge decides to spend all his money on finding his nephews and punishing the evil witch instead. Giro builds a new, super-powerful computer that helps to collect information from agents Scrooge has sent around the world. And the faithful pilot Launchpad is ready to take Scrooge to any corner of the planet.

Help Scrooge to free the kids from captivity and also multiply his fortune many times  ;)

445861.overview:
As well we know, our old friend Prof. Frank was a keen bone collector. With most of his work done in a graveyard, in the grounds of a nearby castle, owned by the vampire Dr. Acula.

And Dr. Acula wasn't very happy about that...

One night, Acula captured Frank and locked him away in his castle. But Frank hatched a cunning plan to escape by constructing a coffin, knowing that it would be impossible for Dr. Acula to resist clambering into it and, once Prof. Frank had nailed down the lid, he would be trapped for all eternity!

Unfortunately, Dr. Acula managed to escape, destroying the coffin and unleashing his hoard of bats on Prof. Frank. The only hope would be to grab a crucifix and send Dr. Acula back into the shadows, while trying to build another coffin...


Colin Stewart (who made Frank N Stein in 1984 and Frank N Stein Re-booted in 2011) recovered the unfinished 1984 game files from cartridges in his loft back in 2011 and intended to complete it, and this has now finally happened. So 40 years later the sequel to Frank N Stein has now been released!

Made in 1984/2024 and released by Colin Stewart in 2024.

449062.overview:
This compilation was bundled with +2 Spectrums purchased from the UK high street electronics chain Dixon's for a time in 1988. It featured ten games from Ocean, their Imagine sub-label, and Dinamic, whose games they published in the UK:

Freddy Hardest
Tank
Slap Fight
Game Over
Athena
Batman (1986)
Head Over Heels
Legend of Kage
Arkanoid
Movie

449569.overview:
Demon Lord is a traditional text adventure. You tell the game what you want to do via a textual interface and the parser is based on verb / noun input.

Th upper half of the screen is used for illustrations and the lower half for the descriptive text and the input.

You control the last of the Knights of King Arthur's round table and the objective is to find and rescue the King and kill the Demon Lord who is holding him.

The game comes in two parts filling 96KB of RAM, the first part is Fortress of Fear, the second Forbidden Forest.

450849.overview: A criminal gang has wreaked havoc in the city kidnapping a group of scientists, the only ones capable of finding an antidote to the virus that they have spread throughout the city. Night falls, it's time to do justice...

450926.overview:
Compilation including the following 4 games:

Combat Lynx
Critical Mass
Saboteur
Turbo Esprit

451054.overview:
Compilation package containing a selection for Data East's own conversions to home computers of their original arcade coin-op games. Featured titles are:

Kung Fu Master
Last Mission
Express Raider
Breakthru

451162.overview:
A collection of five games starring the egg-shaped Dizzy character. All formats include:1. Kwik Snax 2. Panic Dizzy 3. Spellbound Dizzy 4. Dizzy: Prince of the Yolkfolk

Additionally, Amiga and ST versions feature Bubble Dizzy, while C64, Spectrum and Amstrad CPC versions feature the previously-unreleased Dizzy Down the Rapids.

451337.overview:
ZX Draughts is a computer version of the board game checkers, which is also known as English draughts.

The pieces are arranged on the dark squares of an 8x8 board. Play alternates between the white and black pieces. In each turn only one counter may be moved one square diagonally forwards. If an opposing counter blocks a potential move, but there is an empty square on the other side, then you may capture that piece instead by jumping over it, and if you can capture from your new position, you can jump over that piece too. In fact, if you can capture a piece, you must capture, but if there is more than one option, the player may choose which of the pieces to take. Once a piece makes it to the other side of the board, it will promote to a king, which may move or capture diagonally either forwards or backwards. A game finishes when all of one side's pieces have been captured.

Moves are entered by typing the coordinates of the starting square, any intermediate squares (for multiple captures), and the final square for a piece. There are ten levels of difficulty for the computer opponent.

454923.overview:
Deep Zone, a game created by Azimut Soft in 1988, about which little information was available until now.

The objective of the game is to guide the diver Ataulfo ​​through Pac-Orro's underwater temple to obtain the five magical objects before reaching the final door, since it will only open when he has all of them.

455505.overview: Dominoes is an adaptation of the traditional board game where the player competes against one computer opponent. The two players take turns laying domino bricks so that they create a chain of bricks. The bricks are placed so that adjacent numbers match. To win a game the player has to score exactly 72 points. Points are scored when the end dominoes totals a multiple of 3 or 5. So for example if the sum of the bricks is fifteen then the player scores eight points (15/3 + 15/5 = 8). If the sum is not divisible by 3 or 5 then no points will be given. If a player scores higher than 72, the score will be 72 minus the number of points above 72. When the player has used all the bricks, a new game is started but the score will be kept.

456346.overview:
You are Diana, Jorge Romero's eldest daughter.

Your father is a talented independent developer, but he needs a lot of caffeine to work!

The forces of evil are very angry because his games bring fun and happiness to a lot of people, so they have decided to sabotage his next project and have stolen all his coffee cups.

To make things even more difficult they have hidden the coffee in a spooky cavern full of traps and bloodthirsty demons.

But that won't stop the intrepid Diana from recovering Dad's coffees!

457382.overview: Shadows of the Past is an Adventure game, developed and published by Compass Software, which was released in Europe in 1990.

457383.overview: Demon from the Darkside II: The Golden Mask is an Adventure game, developed and published by Compass Software, which was released in Europe in 1987.

457384.overview:
Given the title, one would expect a story about spies, treachery and such, but this is not the case. This is a sci-fi story set in the future on the planet Marego. Rebels are trying to take control of the planet, and the crystal they are using as their power source is polluting the planet. The player controls an exploration party which is almost wiped out by these rebels as they land. There are two survivors, one tough but with limited knowledge, the other weaker but learned.

Due to the nature of the attack neither can think for themselves so the player has to guide both characters through the game so that they return with both the crystal and samples for analysis. The game features a split screen which allows the player to 'see' both agents at the same time, entering 1 or 2 switches control from one to the other.

460866.overview:
Balloon Hopper is a game designed for the ZX Spectrum, created by Andrew Foord. It was first published as a type-in game in the September 1983 issue of Your Computer magazine.

The game was subsequently released under two different titles in Spain: "Don Pepe y los Globos" by Paraninfo Soft and "Transporte Aéreo" by A.V.R. Additionally, it was titled "Octopus" in Germany, where it was published by Hanesoft.

462355.overview:
Delta’s Shadow  is an action platformer for the ZX Spectrum / ZX Spectrum Next, inspired by the “Power Blade 2” game for the NES. Playing as a secret agent Nova and his partner Jacqueline, you will have to plunge into the gloomy atmosphere of the game and fight deadly combat machines and aliens.

Transnational corporation Trigon continues the Delta Foundation job and prepares a new alien invasion. “Delta’s shadow” features more than 20 music tracks, lots of technological locations, stealth, and racing levels.

Destroy the Trigon Corporation and save the Earth from the aliens’ threat!

462358.overview: A text adventure by Larry Horsfield created with the Professional Adventure Writer. This is the third game in The Axe of Kolt series following The Axe of Kolt and The Spectre of Castle Coris. The game is in English even though it has a German title.

462373.overview: A special edition of Dan Dare II that was released on the covertape of Sinclair User Issue #74.

462394.overview: A first person shooter inspired by Quake.  The Dark was originally released as part of Oleg Origin's completion '1997'. It had a later rerelease in 2018 by Bumfun Software. In 2021 Zoysa released a Redux version of the game that also contained a prequel, The Dark: The Lost Pages.

462396.overview:
The Dark: Lost Pages was released on the B-Side of The Dark: Redux.

The main game of Lost Pages is a first person shooter similar to The Dark: Redux, and like The Dark: Redux it consists of 9 levels. There is also a large prologue that proceeds the main game and is a 2D Action-Adventure maze. The goal of the Prologue is to collect all of the pages of the Book of History.

462561.overview: This game is for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum computer and is based on the arcade game Donkey Kong (ドンキーコング) from 1981, designed and published by Nintendo (任天堂) and programmed by Ikegami Tsushinki (池上通信機). This version is freeware made for fun as a programming challenge, and as an exercise in how to solve the well-known colour limitations of ZX Spectrum. It is a tribute to the creators of Donkey Kong and a demonstration that anyone can make nice-looking and well-playable games, even for old cheap home computers that weren't designed for games.

462824.overview:
Devwill Too ZX an Arcade platformer for the ZX Spectrum. 

The game is based on the Mega Drive/Sega Genesis version, but it's not the same game, more like a new game based on the characters and world of the Genesis version.

Game made with the awesome MPAGD from Jonathan Cauldwell.

Key Features:

     At least 15 minutes of full speedrun gameplay
     44 unique screens
     Arcade gameplay with metroidvania elements
     Combo System for additional Score and Challenge

462937.overview: Davy Jones Locker is a text adventure and a sequel to Lockerby's earlier game, Lifeboat. Davy Jones Locker was originally released in a compilation with Lockerby's other game, Challenge, before being rereleased by Zenobi.

462938.overview: A text adventure game for the ZX Spectrum released by Bandit Video Games.

463936.overview: The aim is to move around the screen avoiding the tombstones and walls, catching the demons and hitting the diamond-shaped bonus-point scores.

464072.overview: The object of the game is to find all the four keys and find your way to the Golden Palace where the diamond treasure is to be found.

468325.overview: The Sorceress of Beardopolis has fallen under the yoke of demonic entities seeking the Cursed Grimoire, an ancient tome that holds the secrets to vanquishing these creatures. Prior to her capture, the book's pages were scattered to the furthest reaches of the realm. Your quest is to recover them and rescue the Sorceress, whose whereabouts remain a mystery you must solve. Prepare yourself for an adventure fraught with traps and foes, where every soul you encounter may hold a vital clue to your success.

470895.overview:
Don Ninja is an office worker who, bored with his routine job, dresses up as a ninja at night and tries to help those in need. To do so, he must recover the eight diamonds stolen by the fearsome Black Ninjas and face all kinds of dangerous creatures from the dark forest.

Good luck!

470896.overview:
In a dark time of the Plague in Germany, men were afraid to leave their homes. The streets were empty, and the air reeked of death. In the midst of this chaos, a doctor known as ‘Doctor La Mort’ decided it was time to take action. With a thin pale face and sunken eyes, he was determined to eradicate the plague. But not only that; in his sleepless nights, he had heard rumours of a spawn dwelling in the sewers, an infected being that had to be stopped.

One night, armed with courage and full of bravery, La Mort entered the shadows of the city. As he opened the manhole cover, cold air escaped, bringing with it the stench of decay. Without hesitation, he descended, feeling the chill of the earth grip his bones.

As he walked through the intricate tunnels, the walls seemed to whisper. ‘Don't stop, La Mort!’ a distant voice seemed to say. With each step, the feeling of being watched grew. His hands trembled and his heart pounded, but his determination was stronger. He knew he had to find the spawn.

471135.overview: Dix Mille is a traditional French dice game for 1 to 6 players. A single player can also play against the computer. The game is very simple but extremely addictive as it requires the strategy of a bridge player and the dash of a poker player. The winner is the first player to score 10,000 or more. The program keeps statistics of each game which therefore enables the players to analyse their style of play.

471136.overview: A bomberman clone based on 'Dyna Blaster' for the Amiga and IBM PC and featuring TRD support for the ZX Spectrum.

471138.overview:
In a far and distant future....

As the world's population grew our cities became dangerously overcrowded.

With no where left to build - a solution was found by the world's governments - massive city domes were to be built. These domes would be constructed on the ground where the old crime and disease ridden cities stood. Whole areas were cleared using advanced weapons creating vast deserts. Most of the populous were happy to be at last given a much higher quality of life, but some who fed off the despair created in the old world were not so happy...

Those who refused to comply with the new world order took supplies and equipment to start new lives away from the Domes. These people soon became jealous of the Dome dwellers and soon turned to crime whilst visiting the domes to trade. Life was much tougher on the outside and tensions grew between communities. This escalated into fighting and a tough new policing was needed to protect the Dome's from attack from the outsiders - the Dome Troopers. Heavily armed defence walls were erected.

You were chosen to be a Dome Trooper and posted to City Dome Alpha. It is your role to protect the people and the dome itself. Intelligence suggests that the 'Desert Rebels' have already infiltrated undercover agents into the Dome. They also have many friends who benefit through illegal trade in arms and contraband.

Your contacts tell of their plan to manufacture a drug so powerful and addictive - death will follow within days of taking your first 'fix'. It's name is HAD - High Addiction Drug. To make matters worse they plan to contaminate the dome's self-contained and highly precious food and water supply with this drug.

If the rebels are successful the whole city is at risk and all will be lost.  The rebels will have secured their first stronghold. An official 'neutral zone' was declared as the first tensions arouse. The rebels chose to ignore this 'safe' area and after the defence walls were built the attacks became more and more aggressive. Now the neutral zone is a place of extreme danger. No one ever steps outside the defence wall if they value their lives.

You know your mission, Dome Trooper - City Dome Alpha depends on you.

471140.overview:
There is a deathly hush. Both sides are prepared to meet any threat, and will not capitulate. The missiles are unsheathed from their silos and readied to be hurled across the void to home onto their targets with lethal accuracy. The dreadful silence is shattered by the sound of our commander barking the words that we have feared for so long, yet somehow believed they could never be uttered........ "give us a pint of pina colada, Doris, and a packet of liver'n'strawberry crisps".

Yes folks, it's DARTZ NITE down at the local, and this computerised version is just like the real thing. Skill, luck and overweight drunken slobs, all play their vital part.
